insight.careerSummary: Alex has nine years of full stack experience and already covers the API side of the AI Engineer role. The gap is the machine learning and generative AI stack: Python, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, LLM Application Development and Model Evaluation. The graph shows these form one connected chain, so the path is clear and achievable.
